plain.li: Halfway there. Don't slow down now.
Half of "{AMBITION}" is done. The easy half, probably.
[winter] Halfway through "{AMBITION}", halfway through winter. Neither is giving up.
[afterraid] Even with the raids, we're halfway. That means something.

warm.li: Look how far we've come. Thank you, all of you.

blunt.li: Halfway. Whoever's been slacking, I know who you are.

cheerful.li: HALFWAY! I'm so proud of us I could burst!

gloomy.li: Halfway. Which means half of it can still go wrong.

cold.li: Fifty percent complete. Progress is on schedule. Continue.

plain.li: We're running out of time on "{AMBITION}". A few more days, that's all we've got.
I told everyone we'd do this. Please don't make a liar of me.
[night] Can't sleep. Keep thinking about "{AMBITION}" and how much is left.

warm.li: I know everyone's tired. Just a little more, and we can say we did it together.

blunt.li: Days left and we're nowhere near done. Somebody tell me this is a joke.

cheerful.li: Okay, slight panic! But productive panic! We can still do this!

gloomy.li: We're not going to make it. I knew it. I said it was a good idea anyway.

cold.li: At the current rate, "{AMBITION}" will fail. Reassign labor accordingly.
